comments.npm:serve: Static preview of the built site on http://localhost:3000 (npx serve). Serves what is on disk -- build first, this does not.
comments.npm:cms: Internal editor for the two curated sources, http://127.0.0.1:8787 (override with CMS_PORT). Writes STRAIGHT to packaging/catalog.json and packaging/docs/*.md -- no database, no staging layer, so git diff is the review and git checkout is the undo. Bound to 127.0.0.1 on purpose: it writes to the repo and must not be reachable from the network.
comments.npm:pages: Pages only -- leaves the existing pagefind index alone. Fast loop while editing prose; the search index goes stale until the next full build.
comments.node:tools/cms.mjs: Hidden: this is what `npm run cms` runs. Use the npm script -- launching both would fight over port 8787.
comments.node:tools/build-site.mjs: Hidden: this is what `npm run pages` runs. Use the npm script so the search index stays in the same rail.
comments.python:tools/make-brand-assets.py: One-shot PLACEHOLDER generator: draws website/favicon.png and og-image.png because no square FNSTools mark exists (icons/main.png is a toolbar strip). Needs Pillow. Delete the script and these assets once a real mark lands -- re-running it overwrites whatever is there.
comments.npm:build: The one to use. Generates website/docs/ from packaging/docs/*.md + packaging/catalog.json, restamps the download links in index.html from the published manifest, then rebuilds the pagefind search index. The build validates as it goes and REFUSES to produce a site on a package with no docs, a docs file with no catalog entry, a frontmatter/filename mismatch, or an internal /docs/ link to a page or heading that does not exist. Generated output is committed (Vercel runs no build step), so commit what this writes.
comments.npm:search: Re-index only: wipes docs/pagefind and reruns pagefind over docs/. Use after `pages` if you need search to match.
